fluff.overview: Heavy needler motorized platoons carry M&G flechette rifles and Firedrake support needlers, delivering concentrated clouds of razor-sharp projectiles that shred unarmored targets. Mounted on light vehicles for rapid deployment, these platoons excel at anti-personnel suppression and area denial against soft targets, though flechette weapons lose effectiveness quickly against armored opposition. The Firedrake support needlers extend the suppression effect across wider areas than personal needler arms can cover.
